summary.en: A coloured-core option to discuss against your project specification.
summary.zh: 按项目要求核对红芯板材与饰面配置。

description.en:
Red-core MDF is shown with light and dark decorative surfaces. Start with the finish and application you need, then confirm the exact board grade.
For a project with fire-performance requirements, request the applicable test standard, classification and report for the proposed model before placing an order.
description.zh:
配图展示浅色及深色饰面的红芯密度板。可先按所需外观与用途沟通，再确认具体板材等级。
如项目对燃烧性能有要求，请在下单前核对拟供型号对应的测试标准、等级及报告。

en: Red core with two decorative surface examples.
Discuss core grade and visible finish as one specification.
Fire-performance documentation confirmed against the project requirement.
zh: 红色芯层，配有两种饰面示例。
芯材等级与可见表面作为同一规格核对。
项目所需燃烧性能资料按对应型号确认。

applications.en: Interior panel enquiries requiring a defined board grade and supporting documentation.
applications.zh: 需要明确板材等级及配套资料的室内板材选型需求。

value.en: Red core; light / dark surface examples
value.zh: 红色芯层，浅色／深色饰面示例

value.en: Confirm by specification and order mix
value.zh: 按规格及订单组合确认

value.en: Request current sample terms and production schedule
value.zh: 询价时确认样品条件及当前排产

value.en: Confirm the standard, classification and supporting report for the supplied model
value.zh: 核对拟供型号的标准、等级及配套报告
